title: Horse image is stunning but blanket is as thin as tissue paper
text:
Horse image is stunning but blanket is as thin as tissue paper. Note that this review is for the horse (mare and foal) blanket labeled Pattern 8 on the Amazon site.

My boyfriend ordered this for me on Amazon as a gift because he knows I just love horses. The image is absolutely stunning. I love how regal and gorgeous the mare and foal look. However, the blanket itself is super thin like tissue paper. Although it is soft, I would call it more of a wall hanging than a blanket as it is incredibly thin.

The image gets 5 stars but it is 1 star as a blanket--hence the 3-star rating. The current price of $29.99 is definitely $10 too much for what this is simply because it is so incredibly thin. It is best used as a summer blanket or when one wants something that feels like a sheet covering them.
